title: Serialize canonical manual sales order draft and status mutations
description: Stage3 core canonical sales order workflow. Use existing authenticated live ERP permissions, no new grants or HTTP/test identity bypass. Preserve source audit and all original failure logs. Relevant units, guarded genuine SQL on exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database only; reject existing/wrong targets before access, never drop/reset/read production configuration. Safe Release build/full unit suite required. Build completion is not full stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Use existing DbContext transaction and deterministic quotation then PI then sales-order row lock protocol for update/delete/submit/approve regardless of manual/history/resolved source. Under lock reread current header/details/status/source and live authority before mutation. Preserve source binding eligibility and no silent lineage clear; reject changed preliminary sources or safely resolve in established lock order. No nested transactions or reversed downstream locks. Create writes header/details atomically with existing source locks where relevant.

Legal transitions remain pending edit/delete, pending to submitted, submitted to approved. Reject stale edit/delete after competing submit/approve/cancel. Mixed header/detail replacement and failure after delete/insert/save rolls back completely and clears tracked partial mutations. Deleted/cancelled records cannot revive. Retain existing audit/source/downstream records and shared canonical order lock compatibility with trade documents/procurement/cancellation.

Two independent genuine SQL connections exercise manual edit versus submit/delete, submit versus delete, approve versus cancel, linked and unresolved-history status races, and forced detail replacement save failure. Check controlled losers, exactly one valid final status, coherent full detail set and original lineage, no orphan/revival or downstream writes. Units and safe Release/full suite required.

implementation_evidence: SalesOrderController.Update takes source/order transaction locks only for resolved preliminary sources; no-source and unresolved-history detail replacement runs outside shared order lock. RunLineageGuardedStatusChangeAsync no-source branch reads then saves without transaction; inherited Delete does likewise. Even linked status branch retains tracked pre-lock entity and does not explicitly recheck latest status. ERP347/369 cancellation, ERP397 trade generation and ERP401 linked writes already use order locks; ordinary mutations must join protocol.
